static_traits.name: Mark
static_traits.social_status: 有一些亲密朋友可倾诉，但他们可能not完全理解其工作困境；与同事关系受到影响并出现紧张
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；过去not yet出现类似问题；not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、思路较为条理，能具体描述事件与自动化思维；配合度高、态度积极；情绪以愤怒与失望为主；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得老板讨厌我，永远not会提拔我，这让我在工作中感到被低估并且职业停滞。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the feeling of being undervalued at work has affected my overall well-being and motivation.

special_situations.event: 六个月前not yet获得自己认为应得的晋升
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not被晋升，就说明I am not good enough或上司not喜欢我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works harder, discusses with colleagues and applies for jobs at other coffee shops to seek recognition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 老板一定讨厌我，他永远not会提拔我

special_situations.event: 上周完成一个具有挑战的项目并提前交付，但上司几乎have not表示肯定，反而表扬了同事
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not被直接表扬，就代表我的工作not够好、我not被重视
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using the supervisor's feedback as the main indicator of success, reducing engagement or turning to searching for a new job

special_situations.event: 每次Interacting with supervisor或看到他人被晋升
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人被晋升而我have not，就证明我not如他们、我的职业将停滞
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Discusses complaints with colleagues and applies for other jobs to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not如他们，我的职业生涯not会有进展

special_situations.event: 在工作中回想not yet获晋升与not yet被认可的经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 除非我每次都被认可，否则我做得都not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Takes others' approval as the main standard of success, ignoring other objective performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, it is not good enough

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与被晋升，得到上司的肯定
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被贬低，担心职业永远停滞
defense_goal: 通过疏远上司与降低投入来减少受伤感
把注意力转向求职以缓解被拒的Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 被低估、without力改变处境的员工
object_relations.object_representation: 冷漠、挑剔、not会认可自己的上司

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当上司沉默或表扬他人而not yet肯定自己时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方的沉默理解为拒绝与敌意，认为“他讨厌我、永远not会提拔我”（移情：将被忽视的感受Projection到权威客体）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化词语（如“永远”“从not”），语气激动或坚决，反复强调被讨厌与not被认可，negate其他解释与证据。

manifestations: 感觉在工作中被低估与停滞

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Attributes 'being underestimated' and 'being disliked' to the supervisor's hostility
In counseling, explains one's situation through others' thoughts (such as 'he hates me')

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 以上司的评价作为主要成功标准
出现“我做得永远not够好”的自我苛责

exception_events.target_problem: 在not yet获认可或看到他人被晋升时，来访者通常会感到被低估与愤怒，进而Decreased drive、Work performance affected
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上周，来访者提前完成了一个具有挑战的项目，并保持投入，但当时not yet获得上司的明确表扬
exception_events.reason: not同做法：聚焦在具体任务并按时完成；not同情境：该项目具有明确目标与期限，有助于集中精力

positive_force: 愿意寻求咨询并配合行为实验
Has the ability and commitment to complete challenging tasks (finished a project ahead of schedule)
Has some social support (friends and colleagues to confide in)
negative_force: 过度读心与跳结论、过度概括、心理过滤、negate积极
Self-worth overly dependent on external approval (supervisors' evaluations)

target_behavior.behavior: 在Interacting with supervisor或看到他人晋升时出现强烈愤怒与失望并伴随负性自动化思维
antecedent: 上司not yet对其表现给予肯定
target_behavior.core_reason: 被晋升相关事件激活“我not被重视/I am not good enough”的核心信念及认知偏差（读心术、negate积极、过度概括）
target_behavior.function: Temporarily protects self-esteem through negative attribution and emotional venting, avoiding further setbacks
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased job satisfaction、Decreased motivation、Tense relationships with colleagues

target_behavior.behavior: 工作Decreased motivation与绩效降低（对工作失去投入）
antecedent: 回忆not yet获晋升的经历
观察到上司更认可他人
target_behavior.core_reason: 将外部认可与晋升等同于自我价值，not yet获认可引发without力感与回避
target_behavior.function: Escaping further failure and feelings of rejection, reducing emotional pain
target_behavior.consequence: Career development受阻、求职without果、整体Decline in sense of well-being

target_behavior.behavior: Uses others' evaluations as the main standard of success, ignoring objective data
antecedent: When measuring work success, mainly refers to whether the boss praises or gives extra duties
target_behavior.core_reason: External validation dependence and a 'black-and-white' evaluation framework
target_behavior.function: 寻求外部认可以短暂缓解not确定与Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: negate自身积极表现，持续自我贬低与停滞感
